en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed a cloud session sometimes taking about ten minutes to respond after its process exited while the session still looked live; sending a message now restarts it right away
zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了云 session 的进程已退出但 session 仍显示为活跃时，有时需要约十分钟才响应的问题；现在发送消息会立即重启该 session
